description: Wallets whose large orders (at least $10k) on a Hyperliquid market were followed by a price move in their direction within 30 minutes. Returns a lead score in basis points and a hit rate per wallet. Past activity does not predict future results.
name: get_early_movers

outputSchema.description: Wallets whose large orders preceded moves

formula.description: How the lead score is computed

cancel_ratio_30d.description: Share of large orders cancelled without a fill

hit_rate.description: Share of orders followed by a move in their direction

notional_usd.description: Notional of scored orders in USD
